## Texts and drawings (3)

- **E0419** (text, sure): 内务府 工程 乾隆三十六年 复查 (as quoted in S220). 乾隆三十六年十二月 1771 · S220 section 三; archive not seen · S220. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/ylfj/00baad8cc3da4c6a901378da7919d9a8.htm
  > 绮春园添建宫门、朝房、诸旗房间，并周围添砌虎石大墙，园内龙王庙添建涵洞……清理地面等项工程。
  New gate, offices and guard rooms of the banners after the garden became imperial. S220 glosses the 龙王庙 as in the later 延英论道 area, agreeing with S47. The 诸旗房间 fits the plan's guard house ?旗房 Z-QN07 by name only; this gate is an earlier one, so a guess.
- **E0786** (description, sure): 贾珺: 绮春园龙王庙 from a Yangshi Lei drawing. 2012 · S47 p.117 · S47. https://www.dpm.org.cn/Uploads/File/2018/06/15/u5b23730ae0e5a.pdf
  The dragon-king temple stands in the middle of the 延英论道 area in its own court, water on all four sides, with a one-bay east-facing gate hall and a three-bay main hall. Answers Q11 for QC24: it belongs inside QC28. S220 agrees in placing 龙王庙 in the later 延英论道 area.
- **E0500** (description, likely): 贾珺, 圆明三园中的祀庙祠宇建筑探析, 故宫博物院院刊 2012(3). 2012 · PDF, earlier fetch · S47. https://www.dpm.org.cn/Uploads/File/2018/06/15/u5b23730ae0e5a.pdf
  A survey of the 33 shrines of the three gardens, with dates and forms: ancestor halls, flower god and dragon king temples, 河神庙, 关帝庙. The first thing to read for small temples with little else. Assigned here by type, not checked per temple.
